build_cosmos_controlnet_model: build a CosmosControlNetModel with custom n_controlnet_blocks, model_channels, and attention_head_dim parameters
run_cosmos_controlnet_forward: run the forward pass of CosmosControlNetModel with control latents, base latents, timestep, and encoder hidden states
configure_cosmos_controlnet_conditioning: configure the conditioning scale for CosmosControlNetModel control block outputs as a float or list of floats
enable_gradient_checkpointing_cosmos_con: enable gradient checkpointing on CosmosControlNetModel to reduce memory usage during training
create_cosmos_controlnet_output: create a CosmosControlNetOutput dataclass containing a list of control block sample tensors
